decoded.meaning: SPEC{NAME "type", NAME "stored_value", NAME "name", NAME "temp"} — the minimal in-band vertex-creation spec, the payload of a `:children[]` append
decoded.note: BOTH field values are NAME (0x02), never VALUE (0x01): the terminus pairs a NAME key with a NAME value and skips any other value type, so a VALUE-typed `type`/`name` leaves the selector empty and the create answers INVALID_PATH. Bytes emitted by the libtracer reference encoder.
